name: Tidepool Launchpad
subtitle: Bonding-curve token launchpad
description: Example 5 — bonding-curve launchpad with anti-sniping taxes, per-buyer caps, and graduation into the example-4 AMM. LP is permanently locked at graduation.
long_description: Launch a new token against an ERC-20 quote on a virtual-reserve constant-product curve. Buys in the first snipeWindow pay a linearly decaying tax to a fixed treasury, and per-buyer caps bound early concentration. When the curve raises graduationTarget, anyone can graduate: all curve assets move into an AMM pair and the LP tokens are locked forever at 0x..dEaD. Curve trades are stateless on the launchpad side (~26 state units each). No yield promises, no referral rewards.
